title: Matter core records v1
description: Closed domain-neutral structural contracts. Schemas do not establish authority, reference existence, revision freshness, storage durability, or domain truth.

decimal_string.description: An exact decimal lexeme. It is a string, is never coerced through binary floating point, and is not numerically normalized by matter-json-v1.

pinned_ref.description: Exactly one immutable digest or aggregate revision. Immutable core record kinds require a digest. Mutable aggregate dependencies may pin a revision or the digest of a specific immutable revision snapshot. Namespaced external kinds declare their own pin interpretation.

domain_value.description: An explicitly schema-bound domain value. The core preserves the value losslessly but does not interpret it, authorize it, or validate the external domain schema.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension values; each declares an exact external schema. Unknown well-formed optional extensions are preserved, never executed.

source_content.description: digest is plain SHA-256 of exact original bytes, without the normalized-contract preimage. Bytes may use any source encoding.

observation_input.description: A proposed creation input. The host assigns the commit receipt and initial aggregate revision. Structural admission grants no authority.

occurrence_input.description: A proposed creation input. The host assigns the commit receipt and initial aggregate revision. Structural admission grants no authority.

matter_input.description: A proposed creation input. The host assigns the commit receipt and initial aggregate revision. Structural admission grants no authority.

components.description: Declared named components of this exact immutable proposition. Presence does not imply support for other components or for the whole claim.

claim_input.description: A proposed creation input. The host assigns the commit receipt and initial aggregate revision. Structural admission grants no authority.

quotation.description: Exact source wording offered for citation validation; never normalized or rewritten.

locator_validation.description: The exact immutable adapter-validation receipt for this evidence and locator. Runtime handlers assign and verify this receipt.

evidence_relation_input.description: A proposed creation input. The host assigns the commit receipt and initial aggregate revision. Structural admission grants no authority.

association_proposal_input.description: A proposed creation input. The host assigns the commit receipt and initial aggregate revision. Structural admission grants no authority.

receipt_input.description: A proposed creation input. The host assigns the commit receipt and initial aggregate revision. Structural admission grants no authority.

association_member_dependency.description: Association membership concerns observations, occurrences, and continuing matters. Claims, controls, judgments, and receipts remain evidence or decisions, not membership candidates.

nonnegative_decimal_string.description: Exact nonnegative decimal lexeme for resource ceilings. Signed decimal_string remains available for ordinary domain quantities.

artifact_reference.description: Reference to exact original immutable artifact bytes, or an honest unavailable reason when no verified content digest/locator can be supplied. This does not invent a digest or claim replayability.

raw_result_reference.description: Original result artifact, explicit unavailability, or a declaration that no raw response was produced/applicable. These states are distinct from an empty successful semantic conclusion.

occurrence_grouping_assignment.description: A host-declared dependence group or explicit unknown reason for one immutable root observation. The occurrence runtime checks lineage, scope, authority and current assignments; this shape does not prove independence or create a new source.

dependency_change.description: A local model-record dependency notice. Before references remain historical evidence; notices do not delete records, assert new independent sources, or execute transitive invalidation.

association_member_ref.description: Bare scoped identity of an observation, occurrence, or matter; it asserts no revision, membership, or authority.

projection_dependency.description: An exact service-owned projection snapshot. Its schema and namespace are admitted by the consuming service, not by this generic reference.

association_query.description: A declared host-published catalog query. Complete coverage is bounded by this source, selector, subject, candidate type, and matching rule; no global discovery or continuing-identity assignment is implied.

association_evaluation.description: Frozen matching output recorded in an immutable evaluation receipt. Producer, confidence, and qualification are evidence about evaluation, never permission to accept, override, or merge.
